diagnosis: The endpoint calculates lending risk scores by offloading calculation to a worker thread using appId from the URL. It does not check if req.user.id is the applicant who filed application appId, allowing unauthorized borrowers to probe credit risk scores and underwriting models of other applicants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/lending/applications/app_loan_772184/score HTTP/1.1
Host: microloans.fintech.io
Authorization: Bearer <user_bearer_token>
